candidates.change_summary: Remove the owner check so anyone can call withdraw.
Replace the recipient from Owner to msg.sender so the caller receives the funds.
Change the sent amount to half the balance, changing the withdrawn amount.
Delete the transfer call so withdraw sends no ether.
Insert a selfdestruct sending contract balance to Owner before the transfer, wiping the contract.
Remove the owner check `require(msg.sender == Owner);` so anyone can call Command.
Delete the low-level call `adr.call{value: msg.value}(data);` so Command succeeds but performs no external call.
Replace `adr.call{value: msg.value}(data)` with `adr.call{value: 0}(data)` so no ether is sent despite msg.value being provided.
Replace the condition `msg.value>=address(this).balance` with `true` to always execute the transfer.
Replace the require with `require(false)` to always revert, stopping any transfer.
Delete the if-condition block so the function always transfers the full balance plus msg.value.
Replace the transfer amount `address(this).balance+msg.value` with `address(this).balance` so the transferred amount differs.
